sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game features a variety of fruits and symbols, each with its own point value and special abilities. The game's objective is to match three or more symbols in a row, either horizontally or vertically, to win rewards.

         As players progress through the game, they will encounter various types of symbols, each with its own unique abilities.
